hypothesis: Registration of the otherwise unused HC CUDA module contributes the off TTFT regression through persistent runtime state.
scope: OFF-only mechanism diagnosis, not deployment or performance acceptance

variants.C: HC with its unique constructor entry replaced by RET; four bytes only

lease: one lease for all six requests including loading and gaps
negative_control: two identical runs per variant, second block reverse order
support_rule: R=max within-identity absolute difference. Both blocks require B-A>0, B-C>R and abs(C-A)<=R. Supports registration-state contribution, not a specific CUDA internal mechanism. Not a significance test.
otherwise: Unresolved at this resolution; no claim of noise, equivalence or zero effect; retain NO_GO.
limitations: ELF-relative layout fixed; process ASLR and physical mappings not controlled
No /proc/pressure files on this host; record telemetry errors; cannot exclude all system pressure
Registration starts before HTTP; this intervention tests persistent state, not charging startup time to TTFT
stop_rules: ENV_ABORT or HTTP contract failure stops, no auto retry
No extra probes, warmups, samples or changed criterion
Never run C with MTP; missing HC registration is intentionally incompatible
